text:
marta: quick heads-up: prod-eu embeddings started throwing sporadic 502s for 1-3 token prompts ~5m ago. I traced to tokenizer edge-case on split logic. I have a minimal hotfix image tokenizer-v2.3.1-quickcut that passed staging smoke and integration. Asking for expedited approval for a staged ramp 3% -> 30% -> 100% starting in ~15m. @jorge @ops-duty please ack.

jorge: saw traces, looks safe. +1 if auto-rollback is configured and we pin the image for Dedicated customers. Please provide rollback thresholds.

marta: rollback/abort rules: auto-rollback if 5xx rate increases by >1.8% absolute over baseline for a sustained 4m OR p95 latency regresses >200ms. Manual rollback command: `/deploybot rollback --svc embedder --to previous`. Previous image kept in registry.

ops-duty: oncall ack. Need Dedicated pin sha and a short CS blurb before I can approve. Also set a 30m change window from canary start.

elin: Dedicated pin sha `sha256:feedface00beef...c0ffee`. CS blurb: "Were deploying a tokenizer fix addressing intermittent 502s for short prompts in EU. May see brief degradation during ramp."

deploybot: deploybot: starting staged rollout: service=embedder image=tokenizer-v2.3.1-quickcut steps=3,30,100 auto-rollback=on-threshold.

jorge: metrics team, page on error spike >1.5% absolute.

marta: canary 3% applied. Monitoring 5m.

deploybot: deploybot: canary 3% in place.

marta: 3% looks fine at 6m, moving to 30%.

deploybot: deploybot: rolling to 30%...

deploybot: deploybot: 30% complete, holding telemetry window.

jorge: telemetry looks clean, no spike. Proceed to 100%.

deploybot: deploybot: ramping to 100% now.

deploybot: deploybot: rollout completed to 100% for service=embedder image=tokenizer-v2.3.1-quickcut. No rollback triggered.

ops-duty: expedite approved and closed. Please do a 1h and 3h post-deploy verification and file a short postmortem if anything odd shows up.

marta: will post verification notes in 1h. Thanks all.
